summary.text: Mike Costlow is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 108 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A small business owner who worked in the IT industry, he owned and operated the Village Café of Lake St. Louis.

paragraphs.text: Costlow graduated from Lowndes High School in 2005 and earned a bachelor's degree and an MBA from Western Governors University, the latter in 2018.
His career experience includes working in the IT industry and owning and operating the Village Café of Lake St. Louis.
As of his 2024 campaign, Costlow was an alderman for the city of Dardenne Prairie, Missouri.
For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House General Laws Committee, the Utilities Committee, the House Education Committee and the Children and Families Committee.
